title: MPU6050 NACK with AD0 tied high
serial_logs:
I (330) app: I2C init ok, SDA=21 SCL=22, 400kHz
E (342) app: WHO_AM_I read failed: ESP_FAIL
E (1342) app: WHO_AM_I read failed: ESP_FAIL
E (2342) app: WHO_AM_I read failed: ESP_FAIL
user_question: Logic analyzer shows the address byte gets NACKed.

reference_context.title: MPU-6050 Product Specification (InvenSense)
reference_context.snippet: The slave address of the MPU-60X0 is b110100X which is 7 bits long. The LSB bit of the 7 bit address is determined by the logic level on pin AD0. This allows two MPU-60X0s to be connected to the same I2C bus. When used in this configuration, the address of the one of the devices should be b1101000 (pin AD0 is logic low) and the address of the other should be b1101001 (pin AD0 is logic high).

expected.root_cause: With AD0 tied high the MPU6050 answers at 0x69, but the code addresses 0x68, so the address is NACKed.
expected.fix: Change MPU_ADDR to 0x69 (or tie AD0 low).
